title: Staggered deprecation bridge and day-of-ops slate 2027-07
content:
Purpose:
Compact working plan for a staggered deprecation of the /v1/legacy-generate endpoint and migrating traffic to /v2/generate (quantized model pool). Goal: minimize customer impact, keep unit cost stable, and validate QoR on live traffic. This is a living scratchpad — combine with the formal deprecation policy page before publishing.

High-level objectives:
- 7-day staged migration window with automated rollback gates.
- Canary on 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with hold windows and telemetry checks.
- Post-migration 72h sampling for quality regressions (prompt set A/B).

Owners and on-call:
- Release lead: Maya Patel (owner)
- Runbook steward: Liam Chen
- SRE coverage: Ana Rodriguez (primary), Jordan Kim (secondary)
- Model lead (QoR): Priya Nair

Preflight checklist (must be green before canary):
- [ ] Smoke tests: local and staging end-to-end pass (smoke-suite v3)
- [ ] Telemetry hooks validated: latency, p95, error-rate, token-usage, reject-rate
- [ ] Canary infra: routing rules present in traffic-router v2, fallback routes configured
- [ ] Observability dashboards: per-route, per-model, and per-customer slices pre-created
- [ ] Alerting thresholds set and tested (see below)
- [ ] Customer-exposed deprecation notice published (confluence + email + dashboard banner)
- [ ] Backfill capacity reserved in Dedicated pool (20% headroom)

Day-of schedule (UTC):
- Day 0: 2027-07-20 09:00 - Kickoff call (30m) + announce cadence in #release-ops
- 10:00 - Switch 1% traffic to /v2 (canary-1). Hold 60m
- 11:00 - Verify telemetry + run automated QoR checks against prompt set A (10k samples)
- 13:00 - If OK, advance to 5%. Hold 2h
- 15:30 - Advance to 20% if both QoR and infra metrics green. Hold 4h
- 20:00 - Night hold; report snapshot to execs + product
- Day 1..3: gradually move to 50% -> 100% following the same hold/validation rhythm during daytime windows

Progression rules (auto/pass/fail):
- Gate passes if: p95 latency delta vs baseline <= +15%, error rate delta <= +0.5ppt, model quality (BLEU/semantic-match) delta <= -1.5% on prompt set A/B.
- Gate fails if: any of the following observed during hold window:
  * sustained error rate > 2% for 10m
  * p95 latency > +50% vs baseline for 5m
  * customer severity-1 report arrives for degraded responses
- On fail: immediate rollback to previous traffic split, page on-call, and open JIRA-RED-rollback-<timestamp>

Rollback plan (fast path):
- Re-route traffic to legacy pool via traffic-router rollback endpoint (instantaneous routing flip with 30s propagation)
- Re-scale legacy pool if autoscaling unable to satisfy peak (manual scale by SRE up to +30%)
- Preserve request ids and logs for 24h: correlate failure traces to PRs or model changes

Observability & alerting (must be created ahead):
- Alerts: route-error-rate > 1.5% over 5m, p95-latency > 500ms above baseline over 5m, model-rejects > 0.5%
- Dashboards: route-level waterfall (tokenization -> model -> network), sample-response viewer, QoR sampling panel
- Quick queries (saved): avg_latency(route=/v2, 5m), error_rate(route=/v2, 5m), semantic-regression-score(prompt-set-A, 1h)

Customer comms (templates):
- Pre-migration banner: "Planned migration of legacy generation endpoint begins 2027-07-20. Expect no downtime. Contact support@redwood.ai for concerns."
- Escalation DM (to SRE): "[ACTION] Migration hold triggered at <time>. Observed <metric> breaching threshold. Advise rollback?"
- Post-migration summary (email): short bullets: what changed, dates, observed metrics, any action items for customers

Release notes draft (to include in public changelog):
- Title: "API: retirement of /v1/legacy-generate; migration to /v2/generate"
- Summary: "The legacy generate endpoint will be retired in stages. /v2 uses the quantized-optimized model family with lower median cost per token and improved throughput. Backwards-compatible request schema retained; minor differences in sampling/temperature semantics documented."
- Developer notes: "If you rely on model-specific artifacts (deterministic sampling), pin model version or set seed. Check SDK v2.12.0 for updated client behaviors."
- Known limitations: "Edge cases in structured output mode may differ — see migration guide (linked)."

Post-migration cadence and QA:
- 0-72h: hourly QoR sampling and regression alerts enabled
- 72-168h: daily executive snapshot and ticket triage for any customer regressions
- 30d: finalization: if no high-severity regressions, schedule formal deprecation notice for disabling the legacy endpoint (30-day notice)

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated pool burst capacity with infra finance (cost holdback)
- [ ] Add customer opt-out list for customers who must remain on /v1 for contractual reasons
- [ ] Run load test with synthetic mix matching last 7 days traffic pattern (esp. prefix-heavy)
- [ ] Validate function-calling compatibility for JSON schema passthrough

Notes to self / rough brain dump:
- If small customers see 2–3% semantic delta but enterprise customers complain, treat SLO regression more seriously (escalate to model lead).
- We may want an intermediate 35% step between 20->50 if traffic shape is very bursty for region-eu-west1.
- Consider enabling token-caching on the v2 pool earlier to shave p95 spikes (lazy rollout flag).

Appendix: quick command snippets
- Promote canary 1% -> 5%: curl -X POST https://traffic-router.internal/api/v1/split -d '{"route":"/v2/generate","percent":5}' 
- Rollback: curl -X POST https://traffic-router.internal/api/v1/split -d '{"route":"/v1/legacy-generate","percent":100}'

Record of changes:
- 2027-07-14: initial sketch (Maya)
- 2027-07-16: added SRE owners and alert thresholds (Ana)
- 2027-07-20: day-of notes and timing updates (Liam)

End of scratchpad. Merge into formal runbook once owners sign off.
